data.name: Condition_directors_case_by_case
data.value: These flat amounts are the ones the administration accepts from an employer, and its circular does not apply them to company directors. A director is reimbursed on documents, or on serious and concordant flat norms judged case by case: an advance ruling from the SDA can confirm a flat amount before you rely on it.

data.name: Condition_no_other_company_share
data.value: The company bears none of these costs otherwise: no utilities paid for the office, no share of the internet bill, no company laptop or tablet beside the computer allowance.

data.name: Condition_office_covers_rent
data.value: The office allowance covers the room, its rent included: you cannot also rent the same room to the company.

data.name: Condition_phone_on_invoices
data.value: For the phone, the company reimburses the professional share of your own bills, on invoices: Netto takes the amount you enter as that share.
